violation_type.title: Required Admission Information-Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §744.605(16))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information-Food Allergy Emergency Plan
violation_type.typical_finding: 7 children with diagnosed food allergies did not have signed food allergy emergency plans or medication present for their allergies.

finding_variants.text: 7 children with diagnosed food allergies did not have signed food allergy emergency plans or medication present for their allergies.
Two children who have food allergies did not have food allergy emergency plans on file during the inspection.
Two children did not have a food allergy emergency plan on file at the time of inspection.
The records of three children with food allergies did not have food allergy emergency response plans on file.
Two children with diagnosed allergies did not have the required allergy plan available for review.
The operation did not have a food allergy plan on file for one child who required one.
